_doc: Pearl's catching tutorial (b2tools/patches/capture_demo.py): the two lines of Black 2's capture demo (system text 23, btlv_core), Pearl's words (battle text bank 324 lines 1226-1228, the counterpart's name from bank 497). Black 2 prints them without word buffers, so each counterpart has its own pair: lines 0-1 Dawn's (a boy's counterpart), 2-3 Lucas's (a girl's); CaptureDemo_Line adds 2 x the player's trainer type.

btlv_core.BtlvCore_Text_JustHaveUsePoke: OK! Its HP is down!\nIt’s ready for a Poké Ball!
btlv_core.+BtlvCore_Text_LucasHpDown: All right! I got its HP down!\nTime to throw a Poké Ball!
